entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I'm calling because I'd like to start a return for a helmet I purchased a while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. First, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just a preference. The color wasn't quite what I expected when it arrived. To be honest, the box is still unopened. I just never got around to sending it back.
I see. I just need to pull up your account to check the policy. Could I get your full name and order number, please?
Of course. The name is Samantha Jones, and the order number is VF-8675309.

Thank you, Samantha. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It was delivered about two months ago, so 60 days. Our policy for standard items allows for returns within 90 days. Since you're within that window, I can go ahead and approve this return for you immediately.

Oh, that's great news. I appreciate that. Since I'm going through the trouble of sending it back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? I was looking at some of your other gear.

I'm glad we could process the return for you. While I can't issue a discount for a return based on color preference, I can assure you the return shipping is on us. We'll email you a prepaid label. We want to make sure whatever gear you get next is a perfect fit and provides the best safety for you.
Okay, I understand. No discount code. How about instead of a refund to my credit card, you issue me a store credit with a little extra on top, say 10%? That way the money stays with VeloFit.

That's a clever thought, but our system is set up to process returns directly back to the original form of payment. It's the most straightforward way to ensure you get your funds back. I've just initiated the return for you, and the email with the label and instructions is on its way.
Alright, a full refund is what I originally called for, so I'll take it. Thank you for your help, David.
You're very welcome, Samantha. Was there anything else I could assist with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
